DOCUMENT AUTOMATIONIndependent demo · 2026

LedgerLens.

From invoice to audit trail.

An independent portfolio demo that makes invoice automation reviewable—from document intake to field evidence, purchase-order checks and approved exports.

Role
Product, full-stack & workflow development
Built with
Python · FastAPI · PostgreSQL · Next.js
Source
github.com/KaitoA1008/ledgerlens

The problem

What needed to work.

An extracted value is not enough. Reviewers need its source, a way to correct it, and a reliable record of what was approved.

The workflow

A deliberate path.

  1. Extract

    Read PDF or image invoices by layout and keep where each value sits on the page.

  2. Verify

    Inspect field evidence and purchase-order discrepancies.

  3. Approve

    Create a versioned approval snapshot and export CSV or JSON.

My contribution

Under the interface.

  • Layout-aware extraction with page evidence for every field and line item.
  • Line-level purchase-order matching and discrepancy handling.
  • Manual corrections, reviewer-marked evidence and versioned approval snapshots.
  • A held-out benchmark, background jobs, live updates and CSV/JSON exports.

Engineering decisions

Evidence stays close

The source document and review controls share a workspace.

Approvals are snapshots

Exports correspond to the approved version, rather than an untracked mutable view.

Project context

Independent demonstration using synthetic invoices and purchase orders. On 48 synthetic invoices in eight layouts, the local parser reads 216/216 fields on development layouts and 159/216 on held-out layouts, with 97% of filled values correct; receipts and photos remain weak. Optional LLM extraction has not been benchmarked on real business documents. Screenshots are from the working local application.
